correctness.rationale: The proof explicitly describes every distance class and orthogonally decomposes the complete v+b dimensional space into the r−1 scalar sector, v−1 repeated two-dimensional sectors and one constant two-dimensional sector. Each restriction yields the stated symmetric block, giving an iff criterion. For exponential decay, symbolic determinant identities reduce positivity to w≤1/(k−1) and a single quadratic inequality. At AD(3,3), the quadratic equals 1−54w+416w² and its two exact roots lie in (0,1/8), proving the separated bandwidth intervals, rank drops 26 and 1, and correct a=0 rank one. A standalone checker replays SymPy identities and independently constructs four finite-field graph examples. Computations corroborate but are not used to infer the general theorem.

value.rationale: For all existing affine resolvable designs, the finite positive definite kernel problem becomes one scalar and two 2×2 tests with exact multiplicities. The natural AG(3,3) incidence graph exhibits disconnected admissible positive bandwidth ranges for exp(−a d), with algebraic endpoints and different singularity mechanisms. The nonmonotone covariance boundary is a motivated and usable structural counterexample, not a mere change of symbols or incremental estimate.
